note: Colours for the world around the port (M14): the planet skirt beyond the desert, the outpost placeholder, and the sky in space. Read by src/systems/world/world_scenery.gd and src/systems/world/altitude_sky.gd.

dust.note: Issue #93: blowing sand round the camera (src/systems/look/dust_wind.gd). grains: single grains of sand flying downwind, each wandering on its own (turbulence: how hard the air pushes them about, turbulence_scale: the size of those eddies, turbulence_influence: how much each grain follows them); puffs: slow soft clouds. box = half-width of the emitting box (m), height = its height above the ground, width/length = the quad (m), speed in m/s, alpha = opacity. gust_rate: how often the wind gusts (noise frequency per second); lull: how much dust is left between gusts (0..1). The sand shader's wind_strength makes the matching sheets on the ground.
